تبحبحتم (form IIq)
# تَبَحْبَحْتُمْ (tabaḥbaḥtum) /ta.baħ.baħ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُبُحْبِحْتُمْ (tubuḥbiḥtum) /tu.buħ.biħ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
